title: Staff Platform Engineer
description: Build the internal developer platform our product teams deploy on. You will own the Kubernetes clusters, the Terraform modules and the delivery chain: ArgoCD, Helm, Kustomize and policy as code with OPA, Gatekeeper and Kyverno. Services are written in Go, CI runs on GitHub Actions and golden signals land in Prometheus. Staff level: 10+ years, experience setting standards across teams and mentoring senior engineers.
